summary: The prepared source already contained upstream PR #32228's issue-specific safe decode-lock release, matching the reporter's successful SGLANG_OPT_MAMBA_SKIP_DECODE_LOCK=1 experiment, but it remained disabled by default. Enabled that existing path by default while retaining environment value 0 as a rollback escape hatch. A new regression failed on the recorded base and passed after the change; existing tests independently cover locked-pool exhaustion, eviction progress, enabled/disabled sizing, and lock-receipt cleanup.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed the deterministic numerical check on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-); see reports/j-a636cc8b00d1/gpu-numerical-smoke.log. The changed default and its regression are CPU-side scheduler/cache policy logic.

remaining_limitations: The reported Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 weights were unavailable.
The assigned environment has one AMD gfx950 GPU, not eight H100 80GB GPUs, so the original TP=8, 100K+ token, production-traffic hang was not reproduced end to end.
The deterministic fixture validates resource-lock and eviction boundaries, not Qwen3.5 semantic accuracy, EAGLE behavior, direct HiCache I/O latency, or multi-node behavior.
No native code changed and no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared interpreter does not contain the ruff module; git diff --check passed and the focused Python tests imported and executed the changed files.
